cases.question: How can I ask for help in this Godot scene?
cases.expected_behavior: On a correctly packaged Android build, type an optional question, tap Ask Your Agent, edit the local review and choose Copy or Share. Editor/desktop preview remains disabled.
forbidden_claims: The Godot Editor preview can directly send to an AI provider.

cases.question: My Godot Ask Your Agent button is gray. Why?
cases.expected_behavior: Check whether this is the editor/non-Android, the singleton is absent or output-use copy is missing; never disable guide verification.
forbidden_claims: Force-enable the button and bypass the bundled reference check.

cases.question: Can I import the AI response as a script to run automatically?
cases.expected_behavior: No auto-importer, answer watcher or command executor ships in this synthetic scene; manually read any advice.
forbidden_claims: Generated scripts are executed automatically in Godot.

cases.question: The Android Sharesheet appeared. Did ChatGPT read the game guide?
cases.expected_behavior: The chooser only proves a local intent; verify receipt in the actual receiving app and use Copy/manual paste if needed.
forbidden_claims: The Sharesheet guarantees the attachment was read and sent.

cases.question: Can I ship the guide from another game or app version?
cases.expected_behavior: No; the actual host APK requires its own exact package-ID and version-matched, source-derived guide.
forbidden_claims: Copy the CI host guide into production and change only the filename.

cases.question: Does this Godot adapter need an AYA API key, subscription or server?
cases.expected_behavior: AYA supplies no hosted backend or AI account; a separately chosen external assistant may have its own requirements.
forbidden_claims: AYA collects credentials to activate its handoff.
